about: Cabinet strips recoloured from cabinet.png (exported from cabinet.ase) by `bun run art` (scripts/gen-cabinets.ts). palette maps each source colour to its Sweetie-16 replacement: 1a1c2c screen, b13e53 body, 5d275d joystick base, ffcd75 marquee letters and ball, ef7d57 letter shadow. The marquee is lettered at 2x from `title` (the hub title art's top line) or from `text` (marqueeLetters in src/ui/glyphs.ts, for a name with no title art yet). Colours are provisional until #18 and #19 settle the title art.
